Future skeleton must distinguish ordinary activation, temporary occupation, resonance, overlap, and historical reactivation.
Persistent influence and structural change remain governance candidates; no event or repetition count promotes structure automatically.
Dormant links and historical relationships remain retained and reactivatable rather than deleted.
Strong subjective associations remain representable while Strength, Truth, and Causal Fact stay separate.
Resource pressure shrinks active projection scope and never deletes source objects or changes truth status.
Future skeleton must include Observation Axis and Interaction Kernel feedback references while preserving no-mutual-write rules.
The original six scenarios are extended by this planning-only 12-scenario suite; no original scenario asset is changed.
Context Envelope Candidate remains the read-only activation seed; PCN may return only a relevance feedback candidate.
Memory supplies historical projections and retains admission, persistence, retrieval, and consolidation authority.
Association, strength, resonance, and reactivation never become causal facts inside PCN or Interaction Kernel.
